summary: No blocking integrity finding for the bounded actual runtime screen. Five disposable training arms and eight complete R4 fixed-checkpoint full-QG arms have consistent saved evidence. No new configuration meets strict equivalence, and the fastest record is the existing B64 baseline amid32.83% baseline extraction drift. Retain current settings; do not claim an optimization gain.

nonblocking_findings.detail: ARM0 is the existing T4/W4/B64 baseline, not a new optimization. Identical ARM7 took 93.4516283320s versus 70.3539236160s extraction: last/first=1.3283072717 (+32.830727%). Their extraction+metric ratio is 1.3129377126. ARM0 1.1641536359x extraction or 1.1564688563x extraction+metric relative to the mean of these two baseline runs is not an optimization gain. Each changed setting has only one serial observation; host/second-card interference and run-order effects are not isolated. No stable larger-batch benefit or causal setting ranking is established.

Speed runs saved per-query CSVs, summaries and timing records, but no features, raw distance matrix or full ranked gallery list. This audit independently reduces stored AP values and derives INP from relevant_gallery/last_match, CMC50/rank hits from first_match, plus GT exclusion counts from the sealed original official manifest. It does not independently recompute AP from all positive ranks, raw distances or neural weights. The source field per_query_rank_exact means only first_match and last_match are unchanged, not equality of every gallery rank. ARM0/7 additionally have byte-identical entire CSVs to the selected original.

Each training arm is a fresh disposable seeded build/optimizer using the immutable identity reference, with 3 warm and 24 timed updates at B64/P8K8. It is not continuation from the selected expert checkpoint and not 50-epoch convergence. All 27 identity-name and partial-set sequences match. The W8 arm differs in 23 scalar losses (zero-based updates4..26), maximum absolute difference0.023433685302734375; other four arms have identical27 losses. Worker-count changes alter which worker RNG stream applies augmentation, so paired names do not establish paired image tensors. T1/W4 nominal timing ratio1.0294625008 is a short single screen, not demonstrated durable training acceleration.

R4 inference NVML utilization and total-device memory are genuinely unmeasured; summary nulls are correct. PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks are allocator statistics after warmup reset with the loaded model resident, not all-device/process memory or proof of available model capacity. Training has8 discrete nvidia-smi samples per arm; unweighted mean GPU utilization is55.5/57.25/48.5/52.0/42.0%, sample maxima memory2518/2518/2518/2520/2518MiB. These are device-level time samples, not SM occupancy. CPU busy/iowait uses aggregate host /proc/stat deltas and is not per-process/core utilization. No temperature, power, thermal-throttling or SM-occupancy conclusion is supported.

R4 extraction starts before complete DataLoader construction/worker startup, includes decode, image/metadata transfers, neural forward, normalization and saved feature/route transfers, and ends after CUDA synchronization. The CUDA event interval begins after image H2D and includes camera/scene H2D plus model+float conversion+normalization; it is not pure forward time. total_seconds is extract_seconds+metric_seconds, excluding fresh-process/model construction,64-triplet warmup, concatenation and intervening housekeeping. Actual arm process walltimes93.9168..123.6100s differ from extraction+metric73.7859..102.7735s. Do not call total_seconds complete process walltime.

R1 failed source timing review before execution. R2 inference failed during builder geometry self-check under whole-function no_grad after model initialization/weight loading began, before neural inference forward or any complete QG pass; the five training arms still completed. R3 has exactly one complete QG arm, an actual15s NVML subprocess timeout and observed later inter-arm wait, then scoped SIGTERM/exit-15. The precise lock/call chain causing the stall is unproved. R4 has eight individual arm exit0 receipts plus controller PID875545 exit0 and wrapper/child absence at intake. Detached wrapper PID875544 has no separate native OS wait/exit receipt: its sys.exit(child_code) source plus absence is not an independently witnessed wrapper exit0.

All R4 inference arms strictly load the same original selected axis_shared seed42 E23 best.pth path and report all six metrics from that fixed checkpoint. No score search, metric stitching, new method score, seed search or weight write occurs in this screen. Source guards hash selected weights before/after each completed process and check tensor versions/frozen anchor; this local audit does not independently reread the remote live checkpoint or replay the NN. Original E23 is earliest full-normal benchmark mAP-best across50 epochs, with existing benchmark-selected teacher/configuration; it is not untouched-test evidence. Runtime results concern one RGBNT100 model/server and do not prove cross-dataset, missing-modality, full-training speed, robust superiority or paper-target success.
